title: Parole
summary: PARO'LE, n. [L. parabola.] 1. Properly, a word; hence, in a legal sense, words or oral declaration; word of mouth. Formerly, conveyances were made by parol or word of mouth only.2. Pleadings in a suit

inlines.v: PARO'LE, n. [L. parabola.] 1. Properly, a word; hence, in a legal sense, words or oral declaration; word of mouth. Formerly, conveyances were made by parol or word of mouth only.2. Pleadings in a suit; as anciently all pleadings were viva voce or ore tenus. The parol may demur.
